environment.input_size: Rendered RGB from official test imagery

evaluation.protocol: Complete official test manifest through the production RSVQA endpoint; exact normalized answer match, with overflow-aware count accuracy reported separately.

limitations: Trained specifically on RSVQA-LR and may not generalize to unrelated VQA datasets.
Count accuracy is substantially lower than the other task families.
Counts are learned benchmark labels and are not guaranteed physical object inventories.
The 201+ label represents an overflow class rather than an exact count.
The model is intended for optical or rendered RGB imagery, not raw SAR.
Confidence scores are softmax values and are not calibrated probabilities.
The model does not produce spatial grounding or segmentation.
The model should not replace geospatial measurement or human analysis.
